about.title: About the studio
about.lead: I am a solo artist who finally built the shop I always wanted. Every page, print, and pixel here is made by me.
about.story: My main work is creative development. I build applications and websites. Aside from that I am always doing creative stuff, gaming or making art. I love cute characters.
about.storyGrief: In July 2026, my dad passed away from liver cancer. The grief was so hard to hold and many things felt out of my hands. Somewhere around that time, I noticed people coloring on TikTok and Instagram. I decided to try it myself, bought a 320-piece Ohuhu set and I fell in love! Coloring gave me a small feeling of peace. I could choose the colors, the vibe, the mood. For a while, the page felt like the world I could control. I decided the outcome.
about.storyArt: Out of that feeling came a quiet, but determined idea: what if I made my own coloring books, with my own art? Hiding between the pages are moments of memories of my dad, camouflaged in animals and creatures and scenes that refer to the time we shared together, without making it too obvious.
about.storyHidden: For others it will just be a cute scene or drawing. For the people who knew us and my dad, they will recognize the other part of the story.
about.nameOrigin: The Chinese mark under the English name is {subtitle} (Xiǎo Yì). It grew from {name}: little becomes {xiao}, and memo becomes {yi}, memory.
about.nameShorten: {yi} is a shortened way of saying memory in Chinese. I shortened it because memo is shortened in English too. Chinese has many ways to speak of a memory or remembrance:
nameWords: To recall; look back on the past
about.nameDad: In each of these words, {yi} is the most important part. {yi} sounds like {yiChar}. My dad was {dadName} (Sūn Yìdòng). Even though {yi} is not the same character as his {yiChar}, it sounds the same, and that keeps his name quietly hidden in the word.
about.nameMemo: Memo comes from the English words memory and memorandum: a written reminder. I wanted that word because it feels like a reminder of my dad. In the coloring books I create, I tuck a little reminder of him into the scenes and drawings. I want this website to be that too: always a little reminder of him.
about.nameClose: Through {subtitle} ({name}), I want to share my love for art, and always keep a little reminder of my dad.
about.dadAlt: A photo of me with my dad
